rationale: With a unanimous vote and Roberts emphasizing a narrow, institutional resolution, the Court is most likely to issue a Roberts opinion resting primarily on Article III standing (especially redressability) with an alternative holding limiting relief under § 1252(f)(1). Separate writings are most likely from Gorsuch/Barrett/Thomas to sharpen the § 1252(f)(1) and nonreviewability/prosecutorial-discretion points, and from Alito to stress separation-of-powers consequences.
